topic: building the system is not access to the person who can hire or buy
audience_job: decide, when looking for real work, whether another technical demo moves anything or a specific introduction would
experiment_variable: the opening line: the stack versus the reply

theses.thesis: A working RAG or agent system is not the same as access to a person who can hire or buy; an agency is not an escape hatch when buyer discovery is absent
theses.evidence: The draft's own record: about three years of enterprise algorithm and AI engineering including enterprise OCR/multimodal RAG and a LangGraph customer-support agent, with the public repositories written as post-employment recreations rather than employer source code, and the mechanism it names -- engineering skill produces an artifact, not recruiter discovery, formal review, budget-holder access or procurement
theses.counterexample: Referral networks, inbound communities, established distribution or recurring clients can make self-employment viable for others
theses.reader_action: State a concrete offering, region and requested introduction rather than posting a generic build-agency slogan

theses.thesis: A recruiter greeting is not a verified formal application, and an interview is a separate stage again
theses.evidence: The owner's report of very large volumes of recruiter greetings against few real interviews, with actual unique formal submissions and resume-review rates stated as unknown; the comparator repository records recruiter contacts, application status, resume versions and interview stages as separate lifecycle events and was not installed or run here
theses.counterexample: Some hiring platforms auto-share the resume at first greeting, and stage visibility differs between platforms, so the claim cannot be universal
theses.reader_action: Verify the status of existing candidate opportunities before raising outreach volume

theses.thesis: Actual interview questions concern OCR table structure, RAG limitations, module choice, design documents and workflow/ReAct, not framework collecting
theses.evidence: The owner's account of the questions he is actually asked, against a public project set covering OCR, RAG and agent backends
theses.counterexample: Some jobs genuinely demand specialized model research or different languages
theses.reader_action: Show architecture decisions and failure handling in the project proof

red_team: Objection: referral networks, inbound communities, established distribution or recurring clients can make self-employment viable for others. Answer: the draft records this as the strongest counterexample to its chosen angle and selects the angle anyway for authentic relevance and a direct opportunity call to action; it does not refute the objection.

Objection: some hiring platforms auto-share the resume at first greeting, so stage counts are not comparable. Answer: the draft says the same and rejects the second angle partly for overlapping its earlier send-versus-response draft; no universal claim is made.

Objection: some jobs genuinely demand specialized model research or different languages. Answer: the draft records this as the counterexample to its third angle and sets that angle aside as less direct for a request to seek opportunities.
